comments.value: Yea, just like in TF2 in 2008.
This is gonna work great with the new "Go" button.
I like the idea that the map authors name is shown while loading. that way people will get a bit more recognition for their work on their worlds
That would be really good for many reasons, honestly.
@{59c0e5cd39a9874475bcbfd7|full_name}: It would make the "go" button a little more useful haha
By using this, it would be easier to ad a world description/lore to a world

What my world really says in the description:
`What a Great Pug. - Please use an optimized avatar.`

I think once we have descriptions, they will really be filled with Patreons, Discords, Twitches, and the like.

But I support it being used for what is described here! And showing the world name at the least would be nice.
Would give a use to descriptions other than filling them with random tags so they would show up in searches
@{5a9fe9983955314156acc4f7|full_name}: VRChat could learn a lot from TF2. Valve definitely managed to create something amazing in social aspects of that game, which VRChat lacks a lot, in my opinion.
I keep forgetting what world I go to at times that it be nice to gain a reminder of "Oh! That's right, I'm heading there" instead.

World name is needed here too, and also which #channel number. So i can see if right world is loaded and not by accident switched. 
Also useful when i am "knocked" out and suddenly loading another world. Where am i heading now?

Add world name is very requested option in loading screen.
Don't forget if you are invited by other, you see ONLY world name, but you will miss world description / text. So you will come for example in unknown world and you have no clue what you can do.

Im doing a Mega Canny with all the people request make sure to vote this compilation of Ideas and maybe we are lucky after all this time
https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/feature-loading-screen-needs-to-change-have-an-use-mega-canny-compilation

details:
When the level is loading, aside from showing the player the data usage and helpful hints on how to use VRC, have the loading screen show a print out of the level title, description and level artist.

like:
Now loading: The Great Pug -
Come and join us in the great pug to have a good time.
Created by: OwlBoy

To avoid any accidental texts appearing on the loading screen (some devs used the comments section in the sdk for notes on the level) Have the description only be displayed once a special "Display description upon loading" tickbox has been ticked in the uploader or in the "uploaded content" panel. (similar to setting a avatar private/public)
title: Add a "Now heading to: [WORLD NAME]" to the loading screen
